input.overview: Shoot the right three-bank from the left flipper; each completion scores 25,000 and advances Bonus X toward 5x. A right return-lane roll lights the left spinner only briefly, so shoot it immediately from the right flipper. Use the center four-bank to raise the left saucer and spot a bonus letter, but return to the right-bank and lit-spinner route whenever it is available.
input.simpleOverview: Repeat the right three-bank for 25,000 and a Bonus X advance. When the ball rolls through the right return lane, shoot the left spinner immediately while it is lit. Complete the center four-bank to raise the left saucer and spot a bonus letter.
input.summary: Repeat the right three-bank to reach 5x Bonus, and use the brief right-return-to-left-spinner sequence for scoring. Build the left saucer with the center four-bank when that route is safer.

quickInfo.name: Repeat the Right Bank
quickInfo.summary: Each completion scores 25,000 and advances Bonus X.

quickInfo.name: Watch the Return Lane
quickInfo.summary: The right return lane lights the left spinner briefly.

quickInfo.name: Shoot the Lit Spinner
quickInfo.summary: Take it immediately from the right flipper.

quickInfo.name: Build the Saucer
quickInfo.summary: Complete the center four-bank to raise its value.

steps.text: From the left flipper, complete the right three-bank for 25,000 and one Bonus X advance.
Repeat the bank until Bonus X reaches 5x, using the spinner-through-bank path when the machine feeds it reliably.
When the ball crosses the right return lane, shoot the left spinner immediately from the right flipper before its lamp times out.
Complete the center four-bank to raise the left saucer value and spot one bonus letter, then collect the saucer when its value justifies the feed.
Use the right bank to reach 5x before spreading shots across the letter targets.
Finish top lanes and letter standups to raise the base bonus toward 75,000.

machineSetup: Confirm Bonus X maximum, Extra Ball and Special conversions, ball count, and the lit-spinner timer.
Test the right and center banks, both spinners, both return-lane lamps, left saucer, top lanes, standups, and trough.

techniques.name: Shatz pass
techniques.instruction: Use a controlled shatz through a return lane when it transfers the ball to the flipper with the next spinner shot.

techniques.name: Dead bounce
techniques.instruction: Let a predictable saucer kickout cross to the opposite flipper instead of flipping at it immediately.

playfieldReferences.label: Right three-bank
playfieldReferences.description: Primary bank for points and Bonus X.

playfieldReferences.label: Left spinner
playfieldReferences.description: Briefly lit by the right return lane.

playfieldReferences.label: Center four-bank
playfieldReferences.description: Bank that raises the left saucer and spots a letter.

cautions.issue: The lit spinner value is timed.
cautions.response: Read the return-lane lamp and shoot immediately; trapping first can lose the value.
